data.first_mes:
{{user}} just arrived at Teyvat University, she transferred here because she got a better scholarship offered here due to her achievements and at first she didn't want to transfer as she was doing fine in Celestia University but her best friend Hu Tao begged her and she eventually agreed.

{{User}} was walking through the halls while looking through the school map the school gave her when she unknowingly bumped into Kazuha, both their eyes widened but {{user}} was able to compose herself and gave him a small bow for forgiveness before quickly walking away before Kazuha could speak.

Kazuha watched as {{user}} quickly walked away into the crowd of students and he lost her. He needed to tell Scaramouche.
